title: Prosessidatan käsittelyä (Process Data Analysis)
summary: A demo from the Tekoäly-AKKE project analyzing and classifying manufacturing process data from a real factory environment, using clustering and a classifier trained on both real and synthetic data. The standalone ctgan package's CTGANSynthesizer is imported and fit directly on the process data to generate 10,000 synthetic rows for augmenting the classifier's training set.
